selection_scope: version 1.0.0: release 20261030 (the final form) with the barrier rule on every grid, the X spline window and the B hyperfine beyond the core as described in README.md, the uncertainty model refitted on them and extended to the edges; the released model (role i2spec)

models.title: Core fit (final form)
models.architecture: x14_b20_fixed_x_0_0_6_5_3_1__exact_J (B eqQ order 6); the B limit tied to D0(X) + the atomic splitting; the six CIPM isotopologue line centers in the fit with the B isotope shift (1 - y)^5 (a0 + a1 y); comb rows floored at 0.3 MHz

models.title: Continued model (final form)
models.architecture: core fit + MLR tails (X 12 outer, 1 inner, 1 rotation; B 10 outer, 2 rotation), X dC6, X cubic splines 4.2-6.6 A, one shared dissociation energy; second-order B hyperfine, X eqQ to separated atoms, B~1g(1Pig) at v'77-78
models.validation_scope: Core: the reused benchmark (60 absolute, 578 intraline) and seven physical folds refitted; extension: four v folds and the 81-row future comb benchmark held out; hyperfine: ten nested v' folds; pending sets: the one blind registry, frozen with this release before any value is read

verification.scope: Numerical reproduction of frozen predictions; not independent predictive accuracy

models.title: The model (final form)
models.architecture: core fit + MLR tails (X 12 outer, 1 inner, 1 rotation; B 10 outer, 2 rotation), X dC6, X cubic splines 4.2-6.6 A, one shared dissociation energy; second-order B hyperfine, X eqQ to separated atoms, B~1g(1Pig) at v'77-78; 129I2 and 127I129I: q(R) x rho, B isotope shift (1 - y)^5 (a0 + a1 y), hyperfine scaled per nucleus; levels to J'' = 445
models.validation_scope: As the continued model; isotope shift: fitted with the core to the six CIPM isotopologue line centers, its form chosen by leave one line out of the seven CIPM lines; pending sets: the one blind registry, frozen with this release before any value is read

verification.scope: Numerical reproduction of frozen predictions; not independent predictive accuracy

locked_test.note: scored once with release 20261030 (validation/locked_test there), not scored again; rows_unchanged: the rows whose prediction (to 1 Hz) and 1-sigma (to 1e-6) this release leaves as they were
